Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
DPS Meter
- Added overworld damage recording.
- Overworld encounters automatically save after three seconds without combat or new damage. This delay does not affect DPS.
- Added an overworld-only reset button and /bdr command. Resetting preserves saved encounters and active DoT/buff tracking.
- Manual resets are blocked inside duties. Existing wipe, restart, and combat-end handling remains unchanged.

Interface and Help
- Changed Show DPS meter widget to a left-aligned checkbox.
- Removed the duplicate encounter number and area above the preview.
- Added a disclaimer explaining encounter timing and rounded values.
- Fixed the Widgets Help button opening a missing page.
